title: [BUG] npm is not finding newly published versions of packages

labels.name: Release 7.x
labels.description: work is associated with a specific npm 7 release

body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Current Behavior

When I publish a new version of a package, and then go immediately try to install that version specifically, I am getting an `ETARGET` error, indicating it does not exist in the registry.  However, if I curl directly from the registry, the new version does show up in the `versions` attribute, and the `dist.tarball` url also works fine (I can download the tarball).

Installing with `--prefer-online` does not resolve it.

Running `npm cache clean --force` *does* resolve it.  After running that I can install the new version.

### Expected Behavior

Newly published versions of a package are able to be installed immediately.

### Steps To Reproduce

I was in OS/X at this time.
I have no config other than an email, name, registry, and auth token.

Run:

```
$ npm version patch
v1.0.16
$ npm publish
+ @gar/create-test@1.0.16
$ cd ../scratch
$ npm i @gar/create-test@1.0.16
$ npm i @gar/create-test@1.0.16
npm ERR! code ETARGET
npm ERR! notarget No matching version found for @gar/create-test@1.0.16.
$ npm i @gar/create-test@1.0.16 --prefer-online --loglevel silly
...
npm sill idealTree buildDeps
npm sill fetch manifest @gar/create-test@1.0.16
npm timing arborist:ctor Completed in 0ms
npm http fetch GET 200 https://registry.npmjs.org/@gar%2fcreate-test 42ms (cache hit)
npm sill placeDep ROOT @gar/create-test@ REPLACE for: scratch@1.0.0 want: 1.0.16
...
npm ERR! code ETARGET
npm ERR! notarget No matching version found for @gar/create-test@1.0.16.
$ npm cache clean --force
npm WARN using --force Recommended protections disabled.
$ npm i @gar/create-test@1.0.16

changed 1 package, and audited 120 packages in 756ms

found 0 vulnerabilities
```

### Environment

- OS: macOS Catalina
- Node: 14.17.1
- npm: 7.17.0
